prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1166; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, if that's okay. You can use the claim number.

Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was driving south on a main road in Pearland, Texas, heading to a store near my house. Traffic was moving slowly because of the afternoon rush.

Q: What happened next?

A: The car in front of me stopped, so I stopped too. About a second later I felt a hard hit from behind. My head snapped forward and then back into the seat.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. I checked my mirror a moment before, but I didn't see it closely enough to judge its speed.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle afterward?

A: Yes, it was still running, but the rear bumper was damaged and I pulled into a parking lot. A tow wasn't needed.

Q: Have you noticed any injuries since the accident?

A: Yes. My neck is stiff and sore, especially when I turn my head to the left. My lower back aches when I sit for long periods, and I've had a headache most mornings.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider?

A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same evening, and I've scheduled a follow-up with my family physician. They gave me muscle relaxers and told me to rest and do gentle stretching.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?

A: Only that I want to be sure my treatment is covered and that my vehicle repairs are handled promptly. I'm happy to send any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.

A: Thank you.
